“Ladies and Gentlemen, today I am honored to be in the presence of those who have overcome many challenges to stand before you today. They stand before us, wishing for us to share in there happiest moment of there lives. We have come here, to celebrate and support the choice of Sir Cato and Knight Arctura to join in marriage.”

“Love is a miraculous gift, and a wedding is a celebration of that magic, and that’s why we are here today—to share in that magic.
Marriage is also a place of freedom. Freedom to fully express who you are, knowing that you have someone there to catch you when you fall, encourage you when you are discouraged, and applaud your successes.”

“May the life you choose to share, lavishly fulfill each of you, inspiring you to give abundantly to the rest of the world. May the promises you make here today, reflect the love and sincerity of your truest intention for this union. When life is peaceful and when it is painful, may you continuously be reminded of the beauty and deepest intention of the vows you make here.”

“Arctura, my liege.
I can never know for sure what I was thinking when I volunteered to lose my memories. However  I can take a good guess. I knew that even after I had forgotten you fully, I would fall in love with you again. I knew that we were so tightly bound together in the universe, that I wouldn’t have to worry about not finding my way back.
I promise I will never leave you again. Never forget a single moment we spend together. Never let you down.
I want to spend eternity together Arc. I want to be with until every star goes out. I want to give you the moon itself, in all its beauty.
I promise you Arc, I will be here, with you, always.”
Arc responds, love shining in their eyes:

“Cato. My lover, my friend, my protector, my King. 

Cato, I remember when I lost you. I remember you said that you’d see me soon. I dreaded your absence, but even more, I dreaded your return. I hated the idea that I could have forced you or pressured you or that you would have ceased to love me.

But you came back. In your true beauty, and you loved me as deeply as I love you. 

Cato. I promise that I will love you, and cherish you, and protect you, and that I will forgive and that I will move forward. I will never stop loving you, and I’ll never let go of your verdant eyes again.

When you told me you wanted children too, I couldn’t have been happier. My King, I would raise a thousand children if one of them could be half the man you are.

I love you with all the stars in the sky, all the waves in the sea, and all the trees in the wood. And I will love you until the end of the universe.”
